name: Tabs
summary: Switches between panels of related content in place, or between the pages of one section as links. Not for a value that changes what one view shows (use SegmentedControl), for steps in a process (use a stepper) or for an app's main sections (use Navigation).
a11y: The WAI-ARIA APG tabs pattern: `role="tablist"` named by `label`, each tab a `button` with `role="tab"`, `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`, and one `role="tabpanel"` labelled by its tab and focusable so Tab moves into it. One Tab stop for the whole list (roving tabindex). The current tab is marked by colour and its own indicator, never by colour alone; vertical tabs mark it with a selected fill, never a one-sided stripe. Disabled tabs stay in the list with `aria-disabled` and are skipped by the arrows. Counts are read after the name. `links` is a `nav` landmark of plain links with `aria-current="page"`. Tabs that don't fit scroll sideways to the list's edges; the chosen one is scrolled into view and focus rings sit inside each tab so they are never clipped. Motion (Q65 C6, M14): chosen by a pointer, the indicator slides from the previous tab over the move role; chosen with the arrow keys, it moves at once. Hover and text colours interpolate. Vertical tabs' fill doesn't travel.

keys.keys: Arrow right, Arrow left (Arrow down, Arrow up when vertical)
keys.action: move to the next or previous tab, wrapping; mirrored in right-to-left
move to the first or last tab
shows the focused tab's panel (with manual activation)
moves from the selected tab into its panel

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs, in a meaningful order.

props.name: label
props.description: The tab list's accessible name, e.g. "Project sections".

props.name: variant
props.description: `panels` (default): switch between panels in place (APG tabs). `links`: each tab is a link to its own page, with the current one marked; the same look, as a `nav` of links rather than a tab list.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected tab's id, when the parent owns it. With `links`, the current page.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The first selected tab when the component owns it; the first available tab otherwise.

props.name: activation
props.description: `automatic` (default): a panel shows as soon as its tab is focused, for panels that are already there. `manual`: arrows only move focus and Enter or Space shows the panel, for panels that load or cost something.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` (default) above the panel, or `vertical` beside it for many sections in a wide view.

props.name: extra
props.description: Something that acts on the whole set, after the tabs (an Add or a Filter button).

props.name: size
props.description: From the Button size scale: `normal` (default, 44 px); `s` (36 px) and `xs` (24 px, for a dense panel such as an inspector, by the written dense-surface exception) take smaller text and padding, so a narrow panel's tabs fit without scrolling.

props.name: label
props.description: One or two words, sentence case.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon from the active set; the words still name the tab.

props.name: count
props.description: A count after the name (unread, results), read with it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Can't be chosen now; arrow keys pass over it.

props.name: panel
props.description: `panels`: the content shown when this tab is selected.

props.name: href
props.description: `links`: the page this tab goes to.
